Package io.webagent4j.browsercrawler

package io.webagent4j.browsercrawler
A deterministic, bounded-concurrency browser crawler: JavaScript-rendered link discovery through a real browser session, reusing webagent4j-browser-api for navigation and webagent4j-wait for stability rather than a second wait/timing implementation.

BrowserCrawler is the only implementation of IBrowserCrawler - deliberately a separate contract from ICrawler (webagent4j-crawler-api), since that interface and its CrawlRequest are bound to HTTP-specific fields a browser session/stability/frame/concurrency configuration does not fit. BrowserCrawlRequest is immutable and fully validated at construction; one IBrowser instance is the crawl's session (cookies, storage, and authentication state are shared across every page it opens) and is never closed by the crawler unless the request explicitly opts in.

This module depends only on backend-neutral contracts (webagent4j-browser-api, webagent4j-crawler-api, webagent4j-wait) - never Playwright directly, enforced by dedicated ArchUnit rules. See docs/browser-crawler.md for the full navigation, stability, bounded-concurrency, and determinism contract.
